{{Quote|My flower of blue,<br />I pine for you.<br />Your laugh is so cute,<br />And your head tentacle things are also cute.|Avus Dayne's poem|<ref name="Flower" />}}
'''Avus Dayne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that opposed the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Following the raid on the ''[[Gilded Star]]'' the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]] joined the Alliance and Dayne instantly fell in love with her. After watching her from afar, he eventually composed a poem for her,<ref name="Flower" /> but accidentially sent it to [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] instead.<ref name="Read">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=message|DO NOT READ PREVIOUS MESSAGE|Avus Dayne}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Avus Dayne is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in a letter player receives after '''"Chapter 13: Profit and Plunder."'''
